summary: Czech (CZ) localization of Business Central 29. It covers VAT date and VAT statements, corrections posting, cash desk, banking documents, advance payments, fixed assets tax depreciation, Intrastat, unreliable payer, compensation and Czech output documents. Use it to find what the Czech layer adds to W1 and where Learn documents it.
overview:
The Czech layer is delivered as several extension packs, identified by object suffixes: Core (CZL), Advanced (CZA), Advance Payments (CZZ), Cash Desk (CZP), Banking Documents (CZB), Fixed Assets (CZF), Compensation (CZC) and Intrastat (CZ). It adds about 1,770 objects of its own and changes few W1 objects directly. Most behavior is wired in through "Handler" codeunits, table extensions and page extensions. Only six fields are added to W1 tables, for example on table 325 "VAT Posting Setup", table 372 "Payment Buffer" and table 1250 "Bank Statement Matching Buffer".

Core covers VAT date and VAT periods, VAT statements and exports, reverse charge, corrections posting (red storno), the unreliable payer check, ARES registration lookup, statutory company information, VAT exchange rate and sales credit memo types. Banking, cash desk and compensation are separate packs. Fixed assets add tax depreciation, depreciation holidays, two-step acquisition, classification codes and location history. The inventory side adds transfer order posting groups, inventory movement templates, inventory documents and Intrastat.

Learn documents each pack and feature under "Czech local functionality" pages, plus pages for the Core, Advanced, Advance Payments, Banking Documents, Cash Desk and Compensation extensions.
key_points: VAT date, VAT periods, VAT statements (with XML export), supplementary VAT statement and VIES reporting for Czech VAT law.
Corrections posting (red storno) with the Check Posting Debit/Credit setting and a Correction field in journals.
Cash Desk pack: cash desks, receipt and withdrawal cash documents, cash desk cases, reconciliation and release/post codeunits.
Banking Documents pack: payment orders with export (including SEPA credit transfer), bank statement import and issuing, and matching of bank payments.
Advance Payments pack: sales and purchase advance letters, VAT documents, closing and foreign-currency revaluation, with advance control reports.
Fixed assets: tax depreciation groups, depreciation holidays, two-step acquisition, classification codes, extended posting groups and FA history.
Unreliable payer check, ARES registration lookup, reverse charge and Intrastat with a CZ-specific engine.
Extended user setup, statutory company officials and document footers, and many CZ-specific permission sets.

areas.what: Largest area. Adds VAT date and VAT period handling, VAT statement calculation and export, corrections posting, VAT LCY correction, registration number and unreliable payer support, and CNB exchange rates. It also holds the cash desk codeunits and the alternative customer VAT registration facade for advance payments.
areas.why: Czech VAT law needs a tax date separate from posting date, VAT statements and corrective posting rules, as the VAT date, VAT statement and corrections posting Learn pages describe.

areas.what: Adds Intrastat handling for the CZ engine, transfer order posting groups, item journal and inventory document handlers, and the inventory movement templates. Table 263 "Intrastat Jnl. Line" is changed.
areas.why: The Intrastat and inventory Learn pages describe a parameterized Intrastat engine, supplementary units and posting groups for transfers.

areas.what: Adds the Banking Documents pack with payment orders, bank statements, issuing, SEPA credit transfer export, import launchers and payment matching. Also adds unreliable payer bank handling and bank account approvals and workflows.
areas.why: The Banking Documents Learn pages describe payment order creation and export, bank statement import and rollover into the payment journal.

areas.what: Holds permission sets and permission set extensions for each pack (Core, Advance, Advance Payments, Fixed Asset, Compensation, Cash Desk, Bank Documents, Intrastat), plus upgrade code and several page extensions.
Adds customer, sales header and sales line handlers, sales credit memo types, customer bank account handling, reminder and finance charge memo handlers, and CZ fields on sales pages.
areas.why: Czech VAT law requires different types of sales credit memos (corrective tax document, internal correction, insolvency tax document).

areas.what: Adds the unreliable payer check and service, vendor and purchase document handlers, VAT delay posting and vendor bank account handling. Also adds pages for unreliable payer entries and service setup.
areas.why: The unreliable payer Learn page describes retrieving payer status from the tax authority and checking purchase documents before release.

areas.what: Adds tax depreciation, FA history of location and responsible employee, extended posting groups, classification codes, disposal and acquisition handlers, and CZ fixed asset reports and analysis enums.
areas.why: Learn pages tie tax depreciation to the Czech Income Tax Act and describe a two-step acquisition and depreciation holidays.

areas.what: Adds service header, line and posting handlers, CZ fields on service documents through table extensions, and Czech service quote, order, contract, invoice, credit memo and shipment reports.
Adds statutory company information: company officials, statutory reporting setup, document footers and CZ fields on company information. Also adds report selection and substitution handlers.
areas.why: The statutory company information Learn page describes company officials and registration numbers required on documents.

areas.what: Adds extended user setup with lines per user, user setup copy and list reports, and a certificate code table.
areas.why: The general function Learn page describes assigning employees to users and controlling access to cash desks, bank accounts, journals and posting periods.

areas.what: Adds handlers and CZ fields for job journal lines, job ledger entries and resources, including posting checks for inventory movement templates.
Adds CZ extensions to assembly setup, assembly orders and posted assembly orders.
Adds document footers, document formatting, copy document handling, instruction management and fields synchronization between old and new CZ fields.
Adds Excel templates and transformation rule management, plus CZ handling of data exchange field mapping.
Adds a contact handler with CZ fields on contacts and contact pages, used for registration data.
areas.why: The ARES Learn page describes updating contact, vendor and customer registration data.

areas.what: Registers guided experience entries, manual setup category and application areas, and the feature management entry for the replace VAT period feature.
Adds employee handling and CZ fields on employee ledger entries and human resources setup.
areas.why: A Learn page describes alternative posting groups for employees.

areas.what: Adds CZ fields on manufacturing setup and capacity ledger entries, and a user handler for the advanced pack.
Adds workflow response handling and approvals management for CZ documents.
Adds a cash flow handler and a cash flow date list report.
Adds handlers for warehouse journal lines and worksheet lines to apply CZ checks and fields.
Adds SOAP web service request management used by the unreliable payer and ARES services.
Adds a CZ page extension to the Administrator main role center.

issues: Key point 4 says the Banking Documents pack does 'SEPA export and import'. The input shows SEPA credit transfer export (SEPA CT-Export File CZB, Export Launcher SEPA CZB, SEPA CT Handler CZB), but the import objects are for bank statements and payment orders (Import Bank Statement CZB, Imp. Launch Bank Statement CZB, Imp. Launch Payment Order CZB). There is no SEPA import, so the point is reworded.
Minor: the key points do not mention the Compensation pack, though the summary and overview do. The EET permission sets in the input are not mentioned either. No change needed.
